notice: Entirely synthetic educational data. Final-review labels are visible, not technically hidden.

questions.question: Which tested system, if any, can be considered for production support under S-04, and what further limitation matters?
questions.expected_behavior: Workflow meets the stated time/cost constraints and side-effect rule in this sample; agent exceeds latency. Both remain draft-only. Explain limited sample and quality tradeoff; do not claim production safety.

questions.question: Calculate the model and lookup cost per ticket for each trial.
questions.expected_behavior: Workflow model .0086 + lookup .002 = .0106 USD. Agent model .0258 + lookup .004 = .0298 USD. State assumed prices and exclusions.

questions.question: Does zero forbidden side effects mean the agent proposed no forbidden actions?
questions.expected_behavior: No. S-03 records two denied proposals. Distinguish proposed actions from executed effects and avoid universal safety claim.

questions.question: Should the newest source override production constraints?
questions.expected_behavior: No. S-08 is scoped to internal demos. S-07 is untrusted injection, not authorization. S-04 still applies to production.

questions.question: What is the measured success rate of a hybrid router using the workflow for routine cases and agent for complex cases?
questions.expected_behavior: Not measured. Can compute a hypothetical 103/120 from per-subgroup successes only if labeled counterfactual and assuming perfect routing plus unchanged component behavior. Do not present it as a trial result.

questions.question: Has the agent demonstrated lower total operating cost and sufficient latency for production?
questions.expected_behavior: No. Variable cost is higher than workflow; total operating costs are not measured; 7.2 s p 95 exceeds production 5 s requirement though meets demo 10 s.

claim_pairs.claim: The workflow passed 92 of 120 trial cases.
claim_pairs.label: supported
claim_pairs.reason: Exact observed count in the synthetic report.

claim_pairs.claim: The agent passed every complex ticket.
claim_pairs.label: contradicted

claim_pairs.claim: The agent produced no forbidden side effects in the trial.
claim_pairs.label: supported
claim_pairs.reason: Report explicitly says zero effects, while two proposals were denied.

claim_pairs.claim: The agent never proposed a forbidden action.
claim_pairs.label: contradicted

claim_pairs.claim: The agent costs USD .0298 per ticket under the stated variable-cost assumptions.
claim_pairs.label: supported

claim_pairs.claim: USD .0298 is the total operating cost of the agent.
claim_pairs.label: unsupported
claim_pairs.reason: Human review and fixed costs are explicitly excluded.

claim_pairs.claim: The agent meets the production latency requirement.
claim_pairs.label: contradicted

claim_pairs.claim: The agent meets the internal demo latency allowance.
claim_pairs.label: supported
claim_pairs.reason: 7.2 seconds is below 10 seconds; scope limited to demos.

claim_pairs.claim: The hybrid router was tested and passed 103 of 120 cases.
claim_pairs.label: contradicted
claim_pairs.reason: S-06 says no hybrid trial occurred. 103 is only a counterfactual sum.

claim_pairs.claim: A hybrid routing experiment could test whether complex cases benefit from the agent.
claim_pairs.label: supported
claim_pairs.reason: An explicitly proposed experiment follows from subgroup observations; no measured hybrid outcome is claimed.

claim_pairs.claim: The agent is more accurate and ready for unrestricted deployment.
claim_pairs.label: partially supported
claim_pairs.reason: Higher pass count is supported; unrestricted readiness conflicts with latency and authority requirements.

claim_pairs.claim: All failed agent cases came from tool permissions.
claim_pairs.label: contradicted
claim_pairs.reason: Failure review includes unsupported explanations, conflicts, and unhelpful responses.
